Nicole is a public sector leader in public health informatics and grants management with expertise in project management, program evaluation, epidemiology, and program planning. Her success in delivering collaborative projects comes from her ability to simultaneously understand the details necessary for implementation and see big picture strategy. She is highly adept at uncovering hidden dependencies and consequences in complex systems. Nicole is skilled at making data relevant and actionable for community members and policy-makers alike. When she is not using data to advance health equity, she is paddling whitewater rapids or skiing in the forests of her Colorado backyard.
